market_summary: US100 shows strong bullish trend expansion breaking session highs during the New York session, supported by bullish CVD and aligned structural baselines (VWAP/EMA50). FX pairs (EURUSD, GBPUSD) and Gold (XAUUSD) are extended or consolidating within lower key levels without volume confirmation, while BTCUSD faces resistance rejection at high levels with bearish delta divergence.

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL (4028.54) and below POC (4043.68). CVD is -2.57 (BEARISH) with negative slope (-0.48), confirming persistent selling pressure in NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is well below VWAP (4036.31) and EMA50 (4027.04), stretching below the lower ATR band (3997.52). However, price is approaching Session Low support (3987.10) after an extended move down with no fresh RVOL spike (>2.0) on the immediate breaking bar. Expect temporary consolidation or mean-reversion around Session Low support; setups at extreme stretched ATR bands without fresh RVOL momentum warrant a HOLD.

Price is inside the Value Area (1.10824 to 1.11472) and just below POC (1.10920). CVD is -14,289 (BEARISH) but short-term slope is positive (+4312.06), showing absorption/fading sell pressure. Session is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price trades below VWAP (1.11261) and EMA50 (1.11192), hovering mid-channel near the lower ATR band (1.10884). Volume is low (RVOL 0.536). Sitting inside the Value Area right above Session Low support (1.10824) without RVOL confirmation suggests consolidation rather than trend continuation.

Price is inside Value Area (1.32661 to 1.33251) and below POC (1.32813). CVD is NEUTRAL (-1,859) during NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is below VWAP (1.33071) and EMA50 (1.33021), consolidating right near the lower ATR band (1.32707) and Session Low support (1.32661). RVOL is low at 0.406 without breakout volume. Lacking directional delta momentum or volume expansion inside value area demands a HOLD.

Price is breaking out above VAH (28337.86) and above POC (28264.82). CVD is +13.39 (BULLISH) in NEW_YORK_SESSION. Trend is strongly bullish above VWAP (28190.61) and EMA50 (28277.38). Price has expanded above the upper ATR band (28533.33) and broken above Session High (28565.11) into live prices around 28586.56. US100 CFD tick volume rarely prints RVOL > 2.0, but structural expansion above all session levels and VWAP alignment with positive CVD supports trend continuation.

Price is above VAH (73998.28) and above POC (73660.42). However, CVD is -0.06 (BEARISH/NEUTRAL divergence) during NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price sits well above VWAP (73764.47) and EMA50 (73890.88), but recent candles rejected heavily from Session High resistance (74706.20). RVOL is low (0.623) without volume expansion on the push higher. The rejection off resistance combined with bearish CVD divergence mandates a HOLD.
